scientific_integrity: Analytic proof plus exact rational checker on every labelled graph through six vertices; finite checks are tests, not a proof for arbitrary size; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Independent common casting probability, directed loopless functional graphs, representation of unit ballots only. The original paper already proves the Hamiltonian-cycle mean minimizer and computes first moments; these are acknowledged prior facts. No independent audit, and an unindexed equivalent reliability-polynomial treatment remains possible.
title: Exact ballot-loss distributions and opposing tail risks in default delegation networks
